Ramesh Kumar
--Petitioner
 Versus
State of Uttarakhand & another
--Respondents
Hon’ble Pankaj Purohit, J.
Mr. Sandeep Tiwari, learned counsel for the 
petitioner.
2. Mr. N.S. Pundir, learned Deputy Advocate 
General for the State.
3. Mr. B.S. Parihar, learned counsel for 
respondent no.2.
4. Petitioner has challenged the order dated 
31.08.2026, annexure-8 to the writ petition, whereby 
petitioner has been compulsorily retired from service.
5. It is the case of the petitioner that without there 
being any provision in the Service Rules and in any 
executive order, petitioner has been compulsorily 
retired by respondent no.2.
6. Petitioner submits that even the Government 
Order which has been relied upon by respondent 
no.2 for the said purpose has never been adopted by 
respondent no.2. In such view of the matter, the 
order of compulsory retirement is arbitrary, illegal 
and unreasonable.
7. Respondents may file the counter affidavit 
within three weeks, specifically stating in the counter 
affidavit as to whether there happens to be a Rule to  compulsorily retire in respondent no.2-Corporation 
or not.
8. List on 30.09.2026.
(Pankaj Purohit, J.)
07.09.2026 AK
